60d4ad.title: Web authz review observations
60d4ad.content: Guest detail page calls /api/staff/guests/:id with auth middleware; API requireAuth + requireVenueAccess against guest venue then reservations scoped by guest, so no confirmed IDOR. Admin pages use frontend role middleware but API also requireAdmin per venue. Potential candidate: pages/guests/[id].vue computes backTo from history.state.back if startsWith('/'); protocol-relative `//evil.com` passes and NuxtLink may navigate external, possible open redirect (needs runtime confirmation). Public confirmation/feedback pages accept venue slug independently of booking code; API looks up code globally and does not bind venue, allowing cross-venue rendering/feedback branding but code is bearer and no additional data exposure demonstrated.
